pageCache.text:
Howe Park School
Welcome to Our Nursery and Pre-School
We believe that every child is unique, capable, and full of potential. Our nursery provides a safe, nurturing, and inspiring environment where children can grow in confidence, develop a love of learning, and build the foundations for future success.
Following the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS), we support children across the Prime and Specific Areas of Learning through meaningful play, hands-on experiences, and positive relationships. We encourage children to play and explore, engage in active learning, and develop their ability to create and think critically.
Our carefully planned environment, both indoors and outdoors, offers exciting opportunities for children to investigate, discover, and make sense of the world around them. Through outdoor learning in all weathers, children develop resilience, curiosity, independence, and a deep appreciation for nature.
We place great importance on Personal, Social, Health and Emotional (PSHE) development, helping children to build confidence, form positive relationships, understand their feelings, and develop respect for others. We work closely with families, recognising that parents are children's first educators. Through strong partnerships and regular involvement, we ensure that every child feels supported, valued, and celebrated throughout their learning journey.
We look forward to welcoming you and your family into our nursery community.
Our Vision
Our vision is to create a happy, inclusive, and stimulating learning environment where every child feels safe, valued, and inspired to reach their full potential.
We aim to nurture curious, confident, and independent learners who embrace new challenges, explore their interests, and develop a lifelong love of learning. Through high-quality play experiences, active learning, creative thinking, and outdoor exploration, we encourage children to become resilient problem-solvers who are excited to discover the world around them.
We are committed to supporting children's personal, social, and emotional wellbeing, helping them develop kindness, respect, confidence, and a strong sense of belonging. By working in partnership with parents and carers, we build a supportive community that celebrates every child's achievements and lays strong foundations for their future learning and development.

Howe Park School
Children born between 1 September 2021 and 31 August 2022 start school in Reception in September 2026. Please see the document Howe Park School Primary Admissions Information.pdf for more information about admissions to our school and how places are allocated in line with the oversubscription criteria.
Milton Keynes City Council is the admission authority for Howe Park School. You can view a copy of the admission arrangements for the 2025/26 academic year here and also for the 2026/27 academic year.
Please apply on the council's website using the Citizen Portal MK Schools Admissions Citizen Portal
National Offer Day (for applications received by Milton Keynes City Council by 15th January 2026) is 16th April 2026.
However if you miss this deadline, it is important to apply as soon as possible. Applications received after the national closing date 15 January 2026, will be considered as a late application and will be reviewed after 16 April 2026.
A late application form will be available to download, on the council's website from 16 April 2026.
To contact the School Admissions Team on 01908 253338 or via email primaryadmissions@milton-keynes.gov.uk
More information about applying for a school place can be found at : School Admissions
If you're moving into Milton Keynes or to a different area within the city and want to change your child's school,
You can apply for a school place online using the Citizen Portal MK Schools Admissions Citizen Portal You’ll need to complete a separate application for each child.
You can list up to four school preferences, including your catchment school.
If you need help, please call the School Admissions Team on 01908 253338.
Howe Park School welcome applicants from outside our catchment.
The catchment area is Emerson Valley not including the roads listed below.The following roads on Emerson Valley are in catchment for Merebrook Infant School and not Howe ParkSchool: Alstonefield, Archford Croft, Banktop Place, Beresford Close, Burholme, Cardwell Close, ColdeatonLane (even numbers), Chipping Vale (numbers 2-6 and 1-9), Crosslow Bank, Edstone Place, Fadmoor Place,Gillamore Close, Gratton Court, Hawkshead Drive, Hodder Lane, Pickering Drive (numbers 14-26 and 13--35), Rusland Circus (between the junctions of Hodder Lane and Pickering Drive), Ryton Place, Staple Oak andWolfscote Lane.

The Big Schools’ Birdwatch
The Big Schools’ Birdwatch is in it’s 20th year and it is a brilliant opportunity to get out into the garden or the park, do some bird watching and talk about what you see.The RSPB website has downloadable survey sheets with pictures of birds to look out for.Whilst you’re out there, here are some ideas to talk about with your little ones:• Are the birds big/huge or small/tiny?• What colours are they?• Model the phrase ‘I can see….’ so your child can copy this and add their own ideas• The names of the birds you see e.g. Robin, Sparrow, Blackbird• What are the birds doing? Universal Infant Free School Meals
All children in Foundation and Year 1 and 2 are entitled to a free meal. The school uses an outside provider, Fresh Start, to supply school meals daily.
Though free, meals must be ordered in advance and this is done using an online meal ordering system.
Online ordering has many benefits to you, enabling you to place an order using your smart phone, laptop, tablet or computer.
Registration codes will be issued when your child joins Howe Park. If your child is already a pupil at Howe Park, the office staff will be able to reissue your codes to you.
The web address is: Welcome - Fresh Start Meal Manager (freshstartcatering.uk)

Uniform
Howe Park School Uniform
At Howe Park School we believe that a school uniform promotes equality and encourages focus in learning. We ask all parents to support us in these aims and ensure that their children comply with the uniform laid out below. If you have any difficulty obtaining the uniform please do not hesitate to contact us.
Royal Blue Sweatshirt/Cardigan with or without a logo
Black Skirts/Pinafores/Trousers/tracksuit bottoms
Blue check/striped dress (summer)
Plain Black Shoes or trainers without coloured or white marks
Open toe sandals should not be worn as they do not protect the feet during school activities.
PE kit will be worn for the full day on PE days. Therefore black tracksuit bottoms and the school royal blue sweatshirt can be worn over the PE kit.
Black shorts and a plain white tee shirt
Trainers can be of any colour for PE.
Optional blue Howe Park sweatshirts with or without the Woodpecker logo.
Please remember to name all clothing.
Jewellery and Hair Accessories
Jewellery should not be worn to school, apart from watches and earring studs/sleepers (maximum of one per ear) which must be removed for PE or covered with micropore tape from home. This is to ensure that children are safe from choking or other accidental injury which can be caused by jewellery.
Hair accessories should be simple and in keeping with the uniform colours. Large bows or novelty hairbands are not appropriate. Simple bands to tie long hair back are the only accessory allowed for PE.
In keeping with the ethos of the school uniform, children should not have noticeably dyed hair or wear make up, nail varnish or temporary tattoos for school.
Our school uniform suppliers for our branded school uniform are Kedaph Schoolwear, Lennox Road,Bletchley, MK2 2HH
Website: www.kedaphschoolwear.co.uk
Items without logos are freely available in supermarkets.
If you would like to purchase some second hand uniform please speak to the school office. We will hold a second hand uniform sale on a termly basis
Branded Book bags and drawstring bags for spare clothes are available to purchase from school reception, although these are not required. Children may use other bags for these purposes.
